meta.title: Session Move
meta.description: Drag the handle that appears at the end of a sidebar conversation row onto another project to continue the conversation there. DSH fixes a Session's project when the Session is created and cannot repoint it, so this bundle recreates the conversation: its completed history, tool calls and context are copied into a new Session whose working directory is the target project, and the source Session is then archived. Hold Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) while dropping to copy and keep the source instead; the success notice offers Undo for moves. Plain row dragging stays DSH's own reorder gesture. A directory that is not registered as a project yet can be targeted with Choose folder…, which registers it on the way; the conversation's right-click menu → Move to project… does the same without dragging and lets you pick move or copy first. Every move creates a new Session id and duplicates the source log on disk; background jobs, terminals and scheduled tasks do not move with it. Turning the bundle off removes the handle, the hover hint, the dock and the menu entry, and leaves already moved Sessions as they are.
